reviewType: Independent visual inspection of actual Chromium PNG pixels; two attributed width assignments
scope: Every theory31–38 and chapterIV selfcheck1–23 authored view at320 and1280px

reviewers.role: Independent theory content reviewer and mobile pixel reviewer; author of separate exercise blockA

globalFailure.issue: Four unresolved labels B/P/O/M and four line-through-label reports.

browserRunStatus.meaning: All expected captures are present; the browser gate failed. This visual review does not convert that failed run into a passing run.

method: Mobile reviewer actually opened all46 T-w0320 sheets001–046 and inspected every tile. Desktop reviewer separately opened all40 T-w1280 sheets001–040 and inspected every tile.
Only exact PNG byte-SHA256 identity within a width/group shares a tile; no merely similar diagram substitutes for another.
The synthesizing reviewer independently recomputed all448 source PNG hashes and86 sheet hashes, verified source alias equality and matched the complete expected model view/width roster.
Both reviewers inspected labels, point associations, clipping, geometric marks, correct construction stage, named-case agreement, and letters outside the figure where feasible.

Five mobile originals were separately inspected for dense angle marks, subscript labels, the Z transition/caption, exterior-case omission and median-case omission. Five desktop originals independently confirmed all five case omissions.

The contact-sheet generator preserves source images and uniformly scales complete screenshot images into a2×2sheet; original-size captures were opened where scale or semantics needed closer inspection.

findings.finding: Button «Внешний угол» shows only triangle ABC; D, CD extension and exterior-angle arc absent. Confirmed original PNG and model object; step-5 contains the intended exterior geometry.
findings.requestedChange: Use EXT caseInitial=ext, including D, CD extension and the exterior-angle arc already introduced before the case unlock.

findings.finding: Case «Медиана к гипотенузе» shows only the right triangle, without M and median AM, although the median has been introduced by the unlock step.
findings.requestedChange: Use MEDIAN caseInitial=m1, including M and AM, without importing the later midpoint conclusion.

findings.finding: Named distance case shows bare parallel a/b with A/X, without perpendicular distance segments AB/XY already introduced by its unlock step.
findings.requestedChange: Use PAR_DIST caseInitial=p1, including perpendicular distance segments AB and XY, without importing equality conclusions.

findings.finding: Named distance case shows bare parallel a/b with A/X, without perpendicular distance segments AB/XY already introduced by its unlock step.
findings.requestedChange: Use DIST_PAR_DEF caseInitial=p1, including perpendicular distance segments AB and XY.

findings.finding: Case «Геометрическое место точек» shows only line a and H, omitting P/PH and parallel b already introduced by step 12.
findings.requestedChange: Use LOCUS first constructed H/P/HP/b view without importing final X or converse conclusions.

authoredFix.evidence: Exactly five model view objects changed against the previously reviewed initial model hash. Each now matches the construction already present at its unchanged unlock step. All coordinates, checks, other views, questions and preparation bytes are unchanged. All31 model validations and exact generator equality pass.

resolutionRequirements: Fresh capture and actual pixel inspection of all10 changed view/width pairs.
Unchanged historical pixel verdicts may transfer only on exact fresh PNG hash equality; every additional changed PNG requires actual review.
The independent full browser gate must pass. Initial run40318034439 remains failed regardless of this theory-only review.
limitations: This record does not report post-fix rendering, a passing full browser run, publication or merge approval.
Image inspection verifies rendered diagrams/captions; it is not a replacement for runtime interaction and retained-work tests.
Interior points such as circle centers can correctly have interior labels; corner labels are placed outside figures where feasible.
